How TIME and Statista Determined the Best Companies and Colleges for Future Leaders 2027

In the fourth edition of The Best Colleges and Companies for Future Leaders, TIME and Statista have ranked the 175 companies and 125 colleges that stand out in the career and education histories of U.S. leaders. The list draw on approximately 5,900 influential U.S.-based leaders from business, government, academia, and society. They do not measure reputation or survey opinion.
